scientific_integrity: Classical difference-set formulas and the Hasse bound are credited; numerical checks are not presented as an infinite proof. No claim of independent external certification or publication is made.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to nonzero quadratic residues in fields of odd order congruent to 3 modulo 4. The all-field rigidity proof uses Hasse’s elliptic-curve bound; orders 19 and 23 use exhaustive exact finite checks, and order 11 uses a determinant certificate. Novelty remains subject to historical priority review; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Sharp Paley-residue fourth-moment extension and its phase-rigidity threshold
